newsitem.title: USA: Physician sees Q2 $42 mln pre-tax charge.
newsitem.headline: Physician sees Q2 $42 mln pre-tax charge.

text.p: Physician Reliance Network Inc said Thursday it expected to take a $42 million pre-tax charge in the second quarter ended June 30 and is exploring "strategic alternatives."
The oncology management company said $38 million of the charge relates to writing off accounts receivable it no longer deems collectible.
Chief executive Merrick Reese said in a statement the "company is undergoing a thorough review of (its) management structure and strategic alternatives."

Chief financial officer Michael Murdock, who joined Physician May 28, said in a statement he believed "the adjustment in receivables resulting in the current period charge is appropriate to accurately reflect the company's financial position."
Chief executive Reese said June 19 he was comfortable with a 1997 earnings estimate of $0.43 a share, which would match last year's results.
The company executives were not immediately available for comment.
The company's stock opened at 8-1/4 Thursday, down 3/8.
